name: Gate & rules help
description: The gate plugin's Help mode entries (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Gate & rules
entries.text: What a build must pass before it lands, who lands it, and everything that changed, in eight tabs. The screen only shows what the server answers and sends your taps to it. Same calls as `axf gate …`, the gate_* and lander_* MCP tools and voice.

entries.title: Gate settings
entries.text: This plugin's settings under Settings → Plugins: how often the open tab refreshes, how much History keeps, which tab it opens on, how the lists are drawn, and the lander's limits.

entries.title: Overview
entries.text: The pipeline at a glance: the lander, what is landing, the merge line, how many gates and build rules are on. Tap a tile to open its tab.

entries.title: Gates
entries.text: Every gate rule a PR must pass before it lands, grouped by what it guards. Tap a rule to change it.

entries.title: Gates
entries.text: Every gate rule a PR must pass before it lands, grouped by what it guards. Tap a rule to change it.

entries.title: Build rules
entries.text: Every rule a build has to follow, grouped by when it applies: who does it (the VPS or the build session), its check and fixer, on or off, and how it went last time. VPS rules are done by the VPS and never reach a session's brief.

entries.title: Merge line
entries.text: The Merge queue switch, the line's status, the PRs waiting to land with the rule that holds each one, and the last runs.

entries.title: Merge line
entries.text: The Merge queue switch, the line's status, the PRs waiting to land with the rule that holds each one, and the last runs.

entries.title: Lander
entries.text: The VPS lander that fixes and lands finished builds by itself: its service, the build landing, every build waiting, and Retry or Fix for one that failed.

entries.title: Lander
entries.text: The VPS lander that fixes and lands finished builds by itself: its service, the build landing, every build waiting, and Retry or Fix for one that failed.

entries.title: Limits
entries.text: The lander's limits: how big one PR may be, how often it retries, how long it waits, and how it merges.

entries.title: Model triage
entries.text: Kept for the VPS model triage gate, which is not built yet. Nothing to change here today.

entries.title: Model triage
entries.text: Kept for the VPS model triage gate, which is not built yet. Nothing to change here today.

entries.title: History
entries.text: The audit trail: every gate and merge line change, every build rule change, and every check or fix the VPS ran.

entries.title: Show
entries.text: Pick what the list holds. On Gates: every rule, only the ones on, or only the ones off. On History: which of the three audit lists to read.

entries.title: PR
entries.text: The pull request number to check, for example 705.

entries.title: Check a PR
entries.text: Shows whether that PR can land, rule by rule, from what the lander knows. It changes nothing.

entries.title: Reset to defaults
entries.text: Puts every gate rule back to its default. It asks first; History keeps what was there.

entries.title: Reset this rule
entries.text: Puts this one rule back to its default. It asks first; History keeps what was there.

entries.title: Title
entries.text: The rule's name in every list.

entries.title: What it checks
entries.text: What the rule looks at, in plain words. It shows under the rule's name and in the reason a PR is held.

entries.title: Severity
entries.text: Block: the PR waits until it passes. Warn: it lands and History notes it. Info: only recorded.

entries.title: Run by
entries.text: Who evaluates the rule: the console now, axf-molly once that container owns the gate. A rule is never run by both.

entries.title: On
entries.text: Switches the rule on or off at once. Off rules are skipped.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Sends the changed fields to the server. The change is written to History.

entries.title: Add a policy
entries.text: A new custom gate rule: an id, a title, what it checks and a severity.

entries.title: Add policy
entries.text: Adds the custom rule. It starts on; switch it off or change it from its row.

entries.title: Id
entries.text: The rule's id: lower case, digits and dashes. It can't be changed later.

entries.title: Who
entries.text: Show the rules the VPS does, the ones the session does, or all of them.

entries.title: When
entries.text: When the rule applies: before launch, in the brief, after the build, or at the gate before the PR lands.

entries.title: Kind
entries.text: Mechanical: a check or fixer can do it. Judgement: it needs reasoning.

entries.title: State
entries.text: Filter by state. On Build rules: rules that are on or off. On Merge line: where a PR is in the line (waiting, held, testing, merging, kicked, skipped).

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Find build rules by id, title or text.

entries.title: Add a rule
entries.text: Opens the rule dialog for a new build rule.

entries.title: Edit
entries.text: Opens the rule dialog for this rule.

entries.title: The rule
entries.text: The words a build session reads in its brief, or what the VPS enforces. Keep it to what has to happen.

entries.title: Note
entries.text: Why the rule exists or who asked for it. It is never sent to a session.

entries.title: Who does it
entries.text: The VPS: it is run by the dispatcher, the end hook or the gate, with its check and fixer, and never reaches a brief. The build session: it goes into the brief block you pick.

entries.title: Check
entries.text: How the rule is checked: a command, a checker id, or empty for none.

entries.title: Fixer
entries.text: What the VPS runs when the check fails (for example home-card writes the missing Home card); then it checks again. None = the failure blocks and shows in History.

entries.title: Brief block
entries.text: Where a session rule goes in the brief: the Look, API or Checkpoints line, or the Rules for this job list.

entries.title: Goes to
entries.text: Build sessions only, sessions with Brett only, or both.

entries.title: Builds
entries.text: Limit a session rule to builds that change UI, to builds that don't, or leave it for every build. On the Lander tab: every build waiting to land.

entries.title: Only when the build mentions
entries.text: Comma-separated words. The rule goes into a build's brief only when its title or text names one of them; empty = every build.

entries.title: Cancel
entries.text: Closes the dialog without saving.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Deletes the build rule. It asks first; History keeps the rule.

entries.title: Build
entries.text: The build id the tool works on.

entries.title: Phase
entries.text: Which rules to run for the build: before launch, after the build, or at the gate.

entries.title: Only these rules
entries.text: Rule ids, comma separated, to run only those. Empty runs every rule of the phase.

entries.title: Dry run
entries.text: Checks the build's rules and says what the fixers would write, without changing anything.

entries.title: Run now
entries.text: On Build rules: runs the build's rules now, fixes what fails in the build's worktree (committed on its branch), checks again and writes it all to History. On Lander and Overview: asks the lander for a round now; it runs within a minute.

entries.title: Build title
entries.text: The build's title. Rules that only apply when a build mentions a word look here.

entries.title: Build text
entries.text: The build's description, searched the same way as the title.

entries.title: Changes UI
entries.text: Whether the build changes UI. UI builds get the look rules; leave it to decide from the text.

entries.title: Preview brief
entries.text: Shows exactly what a build session's brief would get from the build rules: only session rules, never VPS rules. It changes nothing.

entries.title: Last result
entries.text: How the rule went the last time the VPS ran it: pass, fixed, fail or skipped (its checker runs elsewhere).

entries.title: Merge queue
entries.text: On: ready PRs go through the stacked merge queue and the one-at-a-time lander is off. Off (the default): each finished build lands one at a time, main merged in first, clashes fixed, then landed. It takes effect at once and is written to History.

entries.title: Why pause
entries.text: Optional: why you pause the line. It shows on the status tile, in History and in the alert.

entries.title: Pause
entries.text: Stops the merge line from starting anything new; what is landing now finishes. Resume carries on.

entries.title: Resume
entries.text: Starts the merge line again in its current mode.

entries.title: Land next
entries.text: Puts this PR at the head of the line. It asks first and still has to pass every rule; nothing is merged directly.

entries.title: Land now
entries.text: Puts a PR at the head of the line in the current mode. It asks first and still has to pass every rule; nothing is merged directly.

entries.title: Check this PR
entries.text: Shows whether this PR can land, rule by rule. It changes nothing.

entries.title: Result
entries.text: Filter by how it ended. Merge line runs: landed, landing, idle or error. Build rule runs: pass, fixed, fail or skipped.

entries.title: How many
entries.text: How many of the last runs to list.

entries.title: Held by
entries.text: The gate rule that keeps this PR from landing.

entries.title: Why
entries.text: Why the PR waits, in plain words.

entries.title: Pause lander
entries.text: Pauses the VPS lander: nothing new is merged, fixed or landed until you resume it. It asks first.

entries.title: Resume lander
entries.text: Starts the VPS lander again.

entries.title: Retry
entries.text: Makes the build's next attempt due now instead of after its wait. Only a failed build can be retried; the lander says when.

entries.title: Retry
entries.text: Makes the build's next attempt due now instead of after its wait. Only a failed build can be retried; the lander says when.

entries.title: Fix now
entries.text: Starts a fix session for the build on the next round, whatever CI says. It asks first. Only a failed build can be fixed; the lander says when.

entries.title: Fix now
entries.text: Starts a fix session for the build on the next round, whatever CI says. It asks first. Only a failed build can be fixed; the lander says when.

entries.title: Land by itself
entries.text: On: the lander merges main in, starts fix sessions and lands builds by itself every minute. Off: it still reads every build but opens, merges and fixes nothing.

entries.title: Lines one PR may carry
entries.text: The size cap. A build whose steps change more lines than this lands as 2, 3 or more PRs, one at a time, in order.

entries.title: Re-runs of a red CI
entries.text: How many times the failed jobs are re-run on the same head before a red CI counts (flaky checks). 0 to 5.

entries.title: First wait (minutes)
entries.text: How long the lander waits before the next attempt after a failure.

entries.title: Wait grows by
entries.text: Each further wait is the last one times this.

entries.title: Longest wait (minutes)
entries.text: The wait never grows past this; attempts never stop.

entries.title: Post every attempt from
entries.text: From this attempt on, each new attempt is posted in the crew chat and on the systems check.

entries.title: Start CI again after (minutes)
entries.text: A PR whose CI never started is pushed again after this long.

entries.title: CI times out after (minutes)
entries.text: CI still running after this counts as a failure and is re-run.

entries.title: A fix session times out after (minutes)
entries.text: A fix session that pushed nothing in this time is a failed attempt; another starts.

entries.title: Merge method
entries.text: How a green PR goes into main: a merge commit, one squashed commit, or a rebase.

entries.title: CI workflow
entries.text: The workflow file whose run decides green or red.

entries.title: Save limits
entries.text: Sends the changed limits to the lander. It checks every value before anything is saved.

entries.title: Rule
entries.text: Only entries for this rule id.

entries.title: PR number
entries.text: Only entries for this pull request.

entries.title: Action
entries.text: Only entries with this action, for example toggle, set, reset, pause, add or edit.

entries.title: Build id
entries.text: Only runs for this build.

entries.title: Since
entries.text: Only entries from this day on.

entries.title: Refresh every (seconds)
entries.text: How often the open Gate & rules tab asks the server again (5 to 600).

entries.title: History size (entries kept)
entries.text: How many History entries are kept; the oldest go first (50 to 20000).

entries.title: Tab it opens on
entries.text: The tab Gate & rules shows first.

entries.title: Show the lists as
entries.text: How the gate's lists are drawn: rows with two lines each, cards, or compact one-line rows. Unset, it follows the skin.

entries.title: Tab
entries.text: Which tab of the Gate screen to open.

entries.title: Open tab
entries.text: Opens that tab of the Gate screen.

entries.title: Build rules tab
entries.text: Open it with console_show view:gate/tab:gate.tabs=build-rules or the voice action gate.build-rules.open. A rule's detail opens with gate.build-rules.open:<rule>.

entries.title: axf gate build-rules
entries.text: The CLI: list, get, add, edit, on, off, delete (two-step), history, runs, run <build> --phase before|after|gate [--dry-run], brief <build>.

entries.title: axf gate auto-lander
entries.text: status, show <build>, run [--now], retry <build>, fix <build>, pause, resume, settings, set <key> <value>. Same as REST /api/plugins/gate/auto-lander and the MCP gate_auto_lander_* tools.

steps.say: Overview: the pipeline at a glance. Tap a tile to open its tab.
Gates: what every PR must pass before it lands. Tap a rule to switch it off or change it.
Build rules: what every build follows, and who does it: the VPS or the session.
Merge line and Lander: what is landing, what waits and why.
History: every change and run, with before and after.
